시편 19:1.content: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

시편 19:2.content: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.

시편 19:3.content: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.

시편 19:4.content: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,

시편 19:5.content: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.

시편 19:6.content: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

시편 19:7.content: The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple.

시편 19:8.content: The statutes of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the eyes.

시편 19:9.content: The fear of the Lord is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the Lord are true and righteous altogether.

시편 19:10.content: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.

시편 19:11.content: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.

시편 19:12.content: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.

시편 19:13.content: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.

시편 19:14.content: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O Lord, my strength, and my redeemer.
